assumptions.effectiveness_definition: assumed probability that an intervention prevents churn for a customer who would otherwise churn

targeting.ordering: descending churn probability, then record reference

projection.roi_definition: net_benefit / campaign_cost (reports render it as a percentage)

undefined_metrics.expected_saved_value: no per-customer value assumption was supplied (monthly_value is None)
undefined_metrics.net_benefit: no per-customer value assumption was supplied (monthly_value is None)
undefined_metrics.roi: no per-customer value assumption was supplied (monthly_value is None)
undefined_metrics.break_even_effectiveness: no per-customer value assumption was supplied (monthly_value is None)

limitations: Expected prevented churn is a fractional expectation, not a count of customers who were actually retained.
Effectiveness is applied uniformly to every selected customer; no segment-specific or heterogeneous uplift is modelled.
The random-contact baseline assumes contact is drawn at random from the same eligible pool and ignores saturation and contact fatigue.
Sensitivity analysis varies one assumption at a time; interactions between budget, cost and effectiveness are not explored.
Cost overrides, when supplied, are assumptions about per-customer intervention cost and are not derived from customer records.

risk_thresholds.semantics: lower-inclusive, upper-exclusive; final tier is upper-inclusive

provenance.randomness: none; selection and arithmetic are deterministic
provenance.selection_order: descending churn probability, then record reference
provenance.random_baseline_population: eligible customers under the same targeting rule
